name: Session Restore Guard
summary: Inject a bounded, integrity-flagged summary of the latest session-ledger checkpoints at session start.
description: On SessionStart, read entries from the ledger's declared 30-day restore horizon and verify chain integrity, then add a short summary as context. The append-only ledger remains locally bounded to 1 MiB until explicit removal. A tampered ledger is surfaced as an integrity failure, never silently trusted; a missing ledger adds nothing.
refuses: It does not block, delay, or alter the observed event; it records or reports only.
It does not execute submitted content, call an LLM, or transmit any data off the machine.
It does not treat unreadable, symlinked, or oversized state as valid evidence.

entrypoints.purpose: Inject a bounded integrity-flagged ledger summary as session context.
